title: Legendary Horns
description: A high-performance Paper/Spigot plugin for 1.21.x that overhauls Goat Horns with tactical combat abilities and introduces a new legendary artifact crafted from the Dragon Egg.
body:
A high-performance Paper/Spigot plugin for 1.21.x that overhauls Goat Horns with tactical combat abilities and introduces a new legendary artifact crafted from the Dragon Egg.

**🐲 The Dragon Horn**

The ultimate survival trophy. Craft this by dropping a Dragon Egg into any crafting slot.

    Heart Infusion: Just carrying the Dragon Horn anywhere in your inventory expands your health bar to 20 permanent hearts (40 HP).

    Dragon's Might: Right-click to blow the horn and receive 8 minutes of Strength III, Speed II, Fire Resistance, and Invisibility. Accompanied by a custom Ender Dragon sound effect.

    Passive Curse (Off-hand): Hitting enemies while holding the horn in your off-hand has a 15% chance to:

        Inflict Wither and Blindness.

        Spawn a damaging Dragon's Breath Pool at the target's feet.

    Cosmetic Trail: Harmless Dragon Breath particles follow the holder (Only visible when held in hand).

    Team Safe: You and your "friended" allies are immune to your own Dragon Breath pools and debuffs.

**🎺 Ability Horns**

Standard vanilla horns now unlock specialized spells. Descriptions are automatically added to the item lore the first time you use them:

-     Dream: Launches an explosive fireball.
- 
-     Ponder: Grants the user Strength IV for 15s.
- 
-     Feel: Freezes enemies in place for 3s.
- 
-     Call: Purges positive buffs (Strength/Speed/Regen) from nearby enemies.
- 
-     Others: Seek (Blindness), Sing (Weakness/Nausea), Yearn (Wither).

**👥 Friend System**

Avoid "friendly fire" by whitelisting your teammates.

    /horneffect friend <player> — Makes a player immune to your horn's negative effects and Dragon Breath pools.

    /horneffect defriend <player> — Removes a player from your whitelist.

**🛠️ Technical Info**

    Compatibility: Native for Paper/Spigot/Purpur 1.21.X.
    Performance: Optimized inventory scanning and particle tasks to ensure zero server lag.

    Cooldowns: All magical abilities respect the standard vanilla goat horn cooldown.

    No Dependencies: Works immediately upon installation without extra mods.
